photos.title: Krabbenspinne Misumena vatia Rose-20190803-RM-085027
photos.description: Crab spider between the leaves of a rose blossom. Focus stack of 15 images.
photos.author: Ermell
photos.caption: A close-up photograph of a pale green crab spider crouched on the edge of a soft pink flower petal, lit by soft natural light against a blurred background of warm coral and white tones.
photos.tell: Image 2 features a spider with incorrect anatomy, possessing only four visible legs instead of the eight legs shown in the real photograph.

photos.title: Clynotis severus, AF 2
photos.description: Clynotis severus, Female, Austin's Ferry, Tasmania, Australia
photos.author: JJ Harrison (https://www.jjharrison.com.au/)
photos.caption: Extreme macro shot of a fuzzy, brown-and-white jumping spider facing forward on a soft green leaf, lit with bright natural light, emphasizing its prominent dark eyes and hairy legs against a blurred green background dominated by earthy browns and vibrant greens.
photos.tell: Image 2 features a spider with cartoonishly round, perfectly spherical primary eyes, whereas Image 1 shows natural, multifaceted compound-lens structures.

photos.title: Green Frog Rana clamitans Facing Left 3008px
photos.description: Photograph of a Green Frogen (Rana clamitans en ). Photo taken at the Tyler Arboretum.
photos.author: Photo by and (c)2007 Derek Ramsey (Ram-Man)
photos.caption: An overhead, slightly angled close-up shows a large green and brown frog resting flat on a textured, sandy-brown stone under natural, even light, with dominant earth tones of olive and tan.
photos.tell: The frog in image 2 features unnatural, perfectly symmetrical dark spots spaced evenly across its back.

photos.title: Grasfrosch new version
photos.description: Common Frog (Rana temporaria). Photo taken near Gruberau (Lower Austria). Most likely a lean, young female specimen, no distinctive markings.
photos.author: Christoph Leeb
photos.caption: A close-up shot captures a brown frog crouching alertly on a mossy, damp stone, illuminated by direct overhead light against a dark, out-of-focus background with scattered autumn leaves, dominated by rich earthy browns and amber tones.
photos.tell: The frog in image 2 features an extra, malformed front limb protruding unnaturally from under its chest area.

photos.title: Banco de peces trompeta (Macroramphosus scolopax), islas Azores, Portugal, 2020-07-27, DD 38
photos.description: School of trumpetfishes (Macroramphosus scolopax), Faial-Pico Channel, Azores Islands, Portugal
photos.author: Diego Delso
photos.caption: An overhead, tightly framed shot captures a massive school of small, silvery fish swimming diagonally across a deep blue ocean, illuminated by brilliant sunlight streaming from the upper right, creating shimmering highlights and a gradient of blue hues.
photos.tell: Image 2 features unnaturally sparse, isolated fish scattered across the water column, unlike the dense, cohesive school tightly packed together in image 1.

photos.title: Arrow blenny (Lucayablennius zingaro) by q phia - Cuba 2017
photos.description: Arrow blenny (Lucayablennius zingaro) on the Coast of Cuba
photos.author: q phia
photos.caption: A close-up shot features a tiny, slender fish with an upturned snout emerging diagonally from a pale burrow within a textured, blurry brownish-orange coral background, illuminated by soft, focused light, with dominant brown, beige, and purple hues.
photos.tell: Image 2 features an extra fish body with visible fins protruding entirely from the burrow instead of just the head emerging.

photos.title: Panoramic view of Wat Pa Phon Phao and Nam Khan river seen from Old French Bridge Luang Prabang Laos
photos.description: Panoramic view of the Buddhist temple Wat Pa Phon Phao, across the muddy Nam Khan river, with green forest and clouds over the hills, during the monsoon in Luang Prabang, Laos.
photos.author: Basile Morin
photos.caption: A wide landscape shot captures a muddy brown river in the foreground, flowing past lush green forests and houses, leading to a golden temple on a forested hill beneath majestic, cloud-capped mountains under a cool, overcast, gray sky.
photos.tell: Image 2 shows a wider, muddy river lacking the grassy foreground banks and distinct vegetation textures seen in the lower left of image 1.

photos.title: Buddhist monks walking in front of the temple Haw Pha Bang in Luang Prabang
photos.description: Group of seven Buddhist monks walking with umbrellas in front of the temple Haw Pha Bang, a sunny day with gray clouds in Luang Prabang, Laos
photos.author: Basile Morin
photos.caption: Under a dramatic grey sky, a straight-on, eye-level shot captures a line of orange-robed monks walking past the bright white base and reddish-brown multi-tiered roof of a temple, flanked by lush green palm trees against red brick pavement.
photos.tell: Image 2 shows monks marching in a single straight line, yet their feet hover awkwardly just above the red brick ground without casting any shadows.

photos.title: Catedral, Segovia, España, 2024-06-14, DD 66-68 HDR
photos.author: Diego Delso
photos.caption: Symmetrical eye-level interior view of a vast Gothic cathedral, dominated by towering stone pillars flanking a central ornate altar beneath a ribbed vault ceiling, illuminated by soft natural light, with warm beige and terracotta checkerboard floor tones.
photos.tell: The checkered floor pattern in Image 2 dissolves into messy, irregular brown shapes instead of maintaining a clear grid near the back.

photos.title: New norcia gnangarra 1 v2
photos.description: The Abbey Church, New Norcia, Western Australia
photos.author: Gnangarra
photos.caption: Under a vibrant blue sky with wispy clouds, a low-angle shot captures a pale yellow church with a red roof, featuring a prominent clock tower on the left and a stone-textured facade flanked by sparse green trees and a palm.
photos.tell: Image 2 features an incorrect red conical roof on the bell tower instead of the domed cupola seen in Image 1.

photos.title: Bodie September 2016 019
photos.author: King of Hearts
photos.caption: Under a bright blue sky, a centered, symmetrical shot captures the front of a weathered wooden barn, framing two silhouetted figures standing in a distant doorway, illuminated by direct sunlight against a dry, rolling landscape dominated by warm browns and rich blues.
photos.tell: In image 2, the bright sun positioned directly above the peak of the roof casts heavy shadows forward, which contradicts the illumination on the scene.

photos.title: Bodie September 2016 016
photos.description: Dechambeau Hotel and I.O.O.F. Hall, Bodie, California.
photos.author: King of Hearts
photos.caption: Framed straight-on in bright daylight, a two-story red-brick building and an adjacent weathered wooden building stand side by side against a clear blue sky, capturing warm earthy browns and reds contrasting with cool blues.
photos.tell: Image 2 features asymmetrical window panes on the top floor, where the muntins on the second window from the left do not align.

photos.title: Ansberg Blickrichtung Süden 120324
photos.description: View from Ansberg near Ebensfeld, Upper Franconia, Germany, in southern direction
photos.author: Ermell
photos.caption: Framed in landscape orientation, natural daylight illuminates the foreground trees with fiery orange and yellow foliage against rolling hills fading into hazy, muted blue and grey layers under a pale sky.
photos.tell: Image 2 shows black, unnaturally thick branch structures visible through the bright orange foliage on the right side of the frame.

photos.title: Altenburg-P1180876
photos.description: The Altenburg in Bamberg seen from the eastern direction
photos.author: Ermell
photos.caption: Centrally framed, a sunlit medieval stone castle with red-tiled roofs and a tall tower stands atop a lush, tree-covered hill, dramatically contrasted against a vast, brooding, dark navy-blue stormy sky with deep blue and green dominant colors.
photos.tell: Image 2 features a red pyramidal roof on the central tower, whereas the real castle in image 1 has a cylindrical, flat-topped observation tower.

sentences.title: Octopus
sentences.text: An octopus is a soft-bodied, eight-limbed mollusc of the order Octopoda.
sentences.fake: Octopuses are intelligent sea creatures with eight arms and ink.
sentences.tell: The AI adds “intelligent” and “ink,” while the human sentence is a neutral taxonomic description (“soft-bodied… mollusc… order Octopoda”).

sentences.title: Eiffel Tower
sentences.text: The Eiffel Tower is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.
sentences.fake: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France.
sentences.tell: The AI omits “on the Champ de Mars” and replaces it with the vague location “in Paris, France,” making its wording less specific than the human sentence.

sentences.title: Honey bee
sentences.text: A honey bee is a eusocial flying insect from the genus Apis of the largest bee family, Apidae.
sentences.fake: Honey bees pollinate flowers, turning nectar into honey while working together in hives.
sentences.tell: The AI sentence adds specific behaviors (“pollinate flowers,” “turning nectar into honey,” “working together in hives”) absent from the Wikipedia-style taxonomic wording.

sentences.title: Volcano
sentences.text: A volcano is a vent or fissure in the crust of a planetary-mass object that allows hot lava, volcanic ash, and gases to escape from a magma chamber below the surface.
sentences.fake: A volcano is a rupture in the Earth's crust through which molten rock, ash, and gases erupt from beneath the surface.
sentences.tell: It says “a rupture in the Earth's crust,” which is narrower and less precise than “a vent or fissure in the crust of a planetary-mass object,” from Wikipedia.

sentences.title: Coffee
sentences.text: Coffee is a beverage brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans.
sentences.fake: Coffee warms the soul, sparking bright thoughts at dawn.
sentences.tell: It’s poetic and vague (“warms the soul,” “sparking bright thoughts at dawn”) with emotional imagery, not the factual, technical process description (“brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans”).

sentences.title: Rainbow
sentences.text: A rainbow is an optical phenomenon caused by refraction, internal reflection and dispersion of light in water droplets resulting in a continuous spectrum of light appearing in the sky.
sentences.fake: Rainbow is a meteorological phenomenon that appears as a spectrum of light in the sky when sunlight is refracted, dispersed, and internally reflected by water droplets.
sentences.tell: “Meteorological phenomenon” is not in the human sentence, and the wording “spectrum of light in the sky” is phrased more generally rather than mirroring the detailed “caused by … in water droplets.”

sentences.title: Moon
sentences.text: The Moon is the only natural satellite of Earth.
sentences.fake: Moonlight spills on silent streets like silver.
sentences.tell: AI uses poetic, personifying imagery (“Moonlight spills,” “silent streets,” “like silver”) rather than a factual, unembellished astronomical statement.

sentences.title: Bicycle
sentences.text: A bicycle, also called a pedal cycle, bike, push-bike or cycle, is a human-powered or motor-assisted, pedal-driven, single-track vehicle, with two wheels attached to a frame, one behind the other.
sentences.fake: A bicycle is a human-powered vehicle with two wheels in a frame, propelled by pedaling that turns the chain and drives the rear wheel.
sentences.tell: The AI adds technical phrasing (“pedaling that turns the chain and drives the rear wheel”), while the human definition uses broader, non-mechanistic wording without chain/rear-wheel specifics.
